title: Normalize MCP task dependency metadata for distillation
goal: Correct the landed MCP façade task record so its dependency list contains only resolvable Core task IDs while preserving the external Commercial plug provenance in the boundary record.

results.reason: The original deps values contained explanatory prose and an external repository commit, which the strict distiller correctly treated as unresolved task IDs. The external Commercial plug remains documented in T-CODEXMCPBUS-1.results.boundary.
